ApiMethod.description: One HTTP method a public route supports.

description: The api fields: one call, or the catalog when the path is not given.

filter.description: Show only catalog routes whose method, path, or description contains this text.

header.description: A request header, as NAME: VALUE.

input.description: The JSON body: the data object, without the HTTP {"data": ...} wrapper.

limit.description: Show at most this many catalog routes.

path.description: The public API path. Without a path, the catalog routes show.

title: ApiArguments
